title: ConvertRange
description: The minimum and maximum amounts allowed for a conversion pair.

from_asset_max_amount.description: The maximum amount that can be converted from.

from_asset_min_amount.description: The minimum amount that can be converted from.

to_asset_max_amount.description: The maximum amount that can be received (converted to).

to_asset_min_amount.description: The minimum amount that will be received (converted to).
